steps.title: Prepare Lipofectamine master mix
steps.instruction: Dilute Lipofectamine 2000 for 96 wells: mix 48 µL Lipofectamine 2000 with 2352 µL OptiMEM, invert five times, then dispense 25 µL of this mixture into each required well using a multichannel pipette.

steps.title: Prepare plasmid master mixes
steps.instruction: For each plasmid, calculate wells to be transfected plus 20 % extra (quadruplicate plus controls). Mix 0.2 µg plasmid per well in 25 µL OptiMEM; e.g., for 10 wells (8 needed +20 % extra) combine 2 µg plasmid with 250 µL OptiMEM, invert five times, and add 25 µL to the appropriate wells, changing tips between different plasmids. Leave one empty column for a media‑only control.

steps.title: Form lipid‑DNA complexes
steps.instruction: Allow the plate containing Lipofectamine and plasmid mixtures to sit undisturbed for at least 20 min but no more than 6 h to enable lipid‑DNA complex formation.

steps.title: Harvest and count cells
steps.instruction: Aspirate medium from a confluent 10 cm dish of ALPK1 KO HEK‑Blue cells, add 10 mL PBS, aspirate, then add 2 mL trypsin‑EDTA and incubate 2–3 min until cells detach. Add 10 mL antibiotic‑free culture media, pipette up‑and‑down to obtain a single‑cell suspension, transfer to a 15 mL tube, mix 20 µL suspension with 20 µL trypan blue, count cells, and confirm ≥90 % viability. Dilute the suspension to 600 000 cells/mL in antibiotic‑free media, ensuring the total volume is at least 10 % greater than the volume required for the experiment.

steps.title: Seed cells onto transfection plate
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL (60 000 cells) of the diluted cell suspension to each well that already contains the lipid‑DNA complexes using a reagent reservoir and multichannel pipette. Return the plate to a 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ incubator for 24 h.

steps.title: Prepare stimulation media
steps.instruction: Make two 3 600 µL master mixes of culture media: for PBS controls, add 36 µL PBS to 3 600 µL media; for ADP‑heptose wells, add 36 µL of 0.5 mM ADP‑heptose to 3 600 µL media (final 5 µM ADP‑heptose). Each well will receive 75 µL of the appropriate mix.

steps.title: Replace media and add ADP‑heptose
steps.instruction: After 24 h post‑transfection, carefully aspirate the existing medium from each well using an 8‑channel adaptor without disturbing the cells. Add 75 µL of the prepared PBS‑containing or 5 µM ADP‑heptose‑containing media to the corresponding wells. Transfer 75 µL of fresh culture media to the empty control column. Return the plate to the incubator for another 24 h.

steps.title: Collect media and lyse cells
steps.instruction: Following the 24 h stimulation, transfer 50 µL of culture media from each well to a new 96‑well plate using a multichannel pipette (change tips each time). Aspirate the remaining media with an 8‑channel adaptor, then centrifuge the plate upside‑down on a stack of tissues for 30 s at 500 × g to remove residual liquid. Add 30 µL SDS lysis buffer to each well, seal the plate, discard the lid, and incubate at 75 °C for 10 min on a heat block. (Optional) Analyze the unstimulated replicate wells by SDS‑PAGE and immunoblotting with anti‑GAPDH and anti‑FLAG antibodies.

steps.title: Detect alkaline phosphatase activity
steps.instruction: Add 150 µL of Quanti‑Blue 1× solution to each well containing the 50 µL of collected culture media (including the media‑only control column), changing tips each time. Incubate at room temperature and measure absorbance at 645 nm every 15 min until an optimal signal‑to‑noise ratio is reached, typically after 1 h.
